# GitHub Copilot Project Instructions

## Project Overview

This is an HTML project that uses GSAP for animation and Tailwind CSS for styling. When making suggestions, please consider the following framework-specific details and conventions.

## Tech Stack

- **HTML**: The structure of the web pages.
- **GSAP**: For animations and transitions.
- **Tailwind CSS**: For utility-first styling.
- **JavaScript**: For interactivity and DOM manipulation.

## Project Structure

Define in file [README.md](../README.md) the project structure, including folders for components, styles, and scripts. Use Tailwind CSS for styling and GSAP for animations.
